descriptions.en: Save text from clipboard history to a local file, preserving quick save and the list or compact layout. History selection uses the native notch picker with no default selection. Cancelling or timing out saves nothing. A successful save uses one NotchAny execution result. Requires NotchAny 1.0.19 or later.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 将剪贴板历史中的文本保存为本地文件，保留快速保存及列表／紧凑布局。历史选择在刘海内完成，不默认选中；取消或超时不保存。保存完成统一使用一份 NotchAny 执行结果提示。需要 NotchAny 1.0.19 或更高版本。

summaries.en: Pick text from clipboard history and save it as md, json, html, or txt.
summaries.zh-Hans: 从剪贴板历史里选一段文本，存成 md、json、html 或 txt 文件。
